## What happened

This notice records a seasonal freeze under ref FRZ-0302. The freeze is titled Bureau seasonal freeze and applies from 2026-12-14 to 2027-01-08. During this period, the stated freeze conditions remain in effect for the relevant bureau work.

## Cause

The recorded cause is Peak post. This cause is associated with the timing of the Bureau seasonal freeze and provides the basis for the period identified in this notice.

## Effect

The effect of the freeze is No template or interface changes. Accordingly, templates and interfaces are not to be changed during the period from 2026-12-14 to 2027-01-08. This notice provides the applicable reference and records the cause, timing, and effect of the freeze for use in related service activity.
